en: A single lightning bolt can heat the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, which is over five times hotter than the sun's surface.
One acre of healthy soil can contain over a million earthworms weighing up to 1,000 pounds in total.
Pumice is a volcanic rock full of trapped gas bubbles, making it the only rock that naturally floats on water.
If all the water vapor in the Earth's atmosphere condensed at once, it would cover the entire planet in about one inch of rain.
A single day on Venus, which is the time it takes to spin once, is actually longer than its entire year.
A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh about six billion tons on Earth.
Since the Moon lacks wind and weather, the footprints left by Apollo astronauts will remain perfectly preserved for millions of years.
An earthquake measuring 6.0 on the Richter scale releases 32 times more energy than a magnitude 5.0 quake.
The massive 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo lowered the average global temperature by about half a degree Celsius for over a year.
The eye of a typhoon is a surprisingly calm, clear, and quiet zone surrounded by the storm's most destructive winds.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant storm that has been raging for over 300 years and is wider than Earth.
The inner core of the Earth is a solid ball of iron and nickel that is as hot as the surface of the sun.
